title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 2
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 2 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. How well do you know the capital city of your country?
2. Do you think cities are exciting places to live?
3. Why do some people dislike living in a city?
4. If you could visit any city in the world, where would you go?

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a time when you read or heard something that you thought was not true.
You should say:
• Where you read/heard this
• What you read/heard
• Why you thought it was not true
And explain how you felt about reading/hearing this thing that you thought was not true.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. Do you think children are more honest than adults?
2. Why do adults tell children it's important to be honest?
3. Do you think there are sometimes good reasons for adults not to tell children the truth?
4. Are there any claims in advertisements that are sometimes not true?
5. Why do people still buy things even when they know advertisements aren't completely accurate?
6. Do you think advertisements that are dishonest should be banned?
